model: Node Cambium Gravel Plus Titanium Frame
description:
The Sanitas Node Cambium Gravel Plus Titanium is handcrafted using hand-selected, size-specific, cold-worked 3/2.5 titanium tubing. Each frame is designed and built one by one in our Durango, Colorado, facility to provide a ride that’s specifically catered to the customer’s riding style and needs in mind.

Our Node Cambium model bridges the gap between our traditional gravel bike and MTB hardtail. As builders, we are seeing a split in gravel bikes between the need for a wide-tire drop-bar MTB and traditional gravel race bikes. The main difference is a suspension-corrected geometry and ample tire clearance to provide the versatility in venturing out on a wider range of terrains. Utilizing a 73mm BB shell and boost rear spacing, the frame will accommodate up to a 29 x 2.3” max tire clearance. Designed to accept 1x drivetrains, UDH rear dropouts, as well as suspension-corrected geometry allowing the frame to accept your preferred rigid carbon or suspension fork (100-120mm Travel). Optional additional mounting points, rack, and fender mounts can be quoted for bike packing adventures.

Choose between a multitude of frame finish options with custom Anodization, Cerakote, or Paint quoted upon request.

The customization does not stop with your frame geometry or finish! Drivetrain and components are just as personal as your riding style! With the ability to hand-select the components of your choice, you have 100% say in building out the bike of your dreams. Complete bike builds are quoted upon request and individualized for each rider.
